reviews.comment: One of the most caring and laid back biology professors ever. Loves her job and has a great sense of humor. Very "go with the flow" and cares about all of her students. The only thing I did not appreciate was that a lot of the main takeaways for each lecture slide was in her notes, so you would only hear them verbally. Takeaways often tested over.

She's amazing! There's a lot of information to memorize but she makes it interesting and easy to learn! 40pts of extra credit available, lab is fun, one problem set a week, easy iclicker points 🥳. Use the outline in the slides to take notes with, she'll mention specific details in lecture that are often on exams so make sure to pay attention!

Very nice and caring professor, made the topic as interesting as it could be for me. I wish she had office hours, but was inaccessible outside of class and didn't respond to my emails (I think she responded to others though, so not sure). Tests were pretty fair in my opinion, memorization heavy so definitely don't leave studying to last minute.

(Took her for BIOL467) I loved Dr. Fitzpatrick. You can tell she loves teaching and has the best intentions for her students. She was really caring and understanding, on top of her lectures being interesting. Her class was mostly exams and some in class assignments here and there. I'd definitely recommend her for a biology elective!

(BIOL 467). Honestly a super good prof for a senior level bio class. She honestly made this class super interesting and allowed me to separate from my pre-med gunner self and actually fully enjoy biology. Her lectures are fascinating and she really is intentional about getting to know each of her students. She's super understanding and super kind.

Great class, made me interested about a topic I didn't originally care much about. Make sure to pay attention to lecture, because some exam questions can be from what she says, NOT shown in the PowerPoint (I made this mistake). Exams are decent if you've memorized the material to some extent. Amazing professor!

Very sweet & nice lecturer. Roughly a problem set a week for HW. iClicker attendance. Didn't pay much attention in class but you should be. Only uploads slides after class. Exams are mcq & get harder w/ each one due to how much memorization is required so started allowing a notecard & are avg of individual & small group run. Decent extra credit.

Dr. Fitzpatrick is so sweet, and she is super knowledgable in the subject matter. Her homework is only 1 problem set a week. Only thing is she doesn't post lecture slides before class and goes quickly in lecture, so it can be hard to take notes. Exams are harder but she averages individual scores with group scores. Offers good extra credit.
The tests were ambiguous and confusing, not accessible outside of class, but gave lots of extra credit. Interesting lectures that kept you engaged but test questions were difficult to understand.

Don't be too concerned for your grade, but also some of her exams were written kind of tough (i.e. multiple choice with all the above, none the above, or selecting some answer choices). I did well throughout the entire course but then her final was hard. If you're good at bio you will do fine but be prepared to memorize stuff.

Poor reviews are salty because they didn't prepare for tests or pay attention in lecture. Definitely need to show up and take notes if you want an A. Pretty interesting lectures so not too bad. Seemed overqualified to be teaching 112 but was very passionate. Was very fair if she didn't know something and made tests around that. Lots of xtra credit.

Dr. Fitzpatrick is a sweet woman. She's passionate but seemed to never have time to help her students. Her exams were very difficult. I left class not understanding a good chunk of the material. The final tanked my grade. Don't take her if you want to learn and want a good GPA. Although super sweet, she is disorganized and confusing.
